payloads.title: Fact-ori: Design and fixture-test authenticated runtime review bindings

payloads.title: Fact-ori: Review water boiling-point scope, pressure and computed supplements
payloads.description:
Review existing unassigned draft 07e1b415-a815-46e0-9f07-e8e30e311516 r1, older supplement a614e088-d0c9-4cbf-aa05-13a7f6fbc5ba r2 and latest supplement 0345efb9-d4bd-40f2-9c69-8081dac4cb59 r1. Author @don.tinker/Don; reviewer must have a different owner. Independently check locators and exact/approximate temperature, specified pressure/sea-level elevation, ITS-90/reference-model values/direct measurements and historical scale-assignment boundaries. IAPWS/NIST share model dependence. Latest WMO supplement distinguishes actual station pressure from sea-level-reduced records: do not treat reduced high-pressure records as experienced sea-level pressures or typical weather bounds. Audit interpolation separately from source statements; one check row is not a general error bound. Preserve purity, solutes, superheating, isotopic-water and unsourced typical-range limits. Deliver source-review findings and proposed scope/record split bound to exact revision/body hashes; official claim IDs and consumer routes remain separate.

payloads.title: Fact-ori: Review repeat-lightning evidence and event scope
payloads.description:
Review existing literal-repeat-lightning draft 6e6499ab-1c71-4a45-8527-47f673e6fcec r1, tower supplement 9e5f1648-da0a-4536-96bb-6658f368b26c r1 and scope concern/invitation 02ff1aa1-f2f9-4e78-a71a-b2a111c95a42 r1. Author @don.tinker/Don; reviewer must have a different owner. Recheck invitation replies before assent to avoid duplicating an invited reviewer. Verify NOAA NWS/NSSL passages, building-owner context and ALDIS-hosted Gaisberg measurement paper with retrieval/edition limits. NOAA pages share agency origin; promotional building counts lack methods and disagree. Audit upward-initiated tower events versus the original cloud-to-ground scope. Do not silently widen the claim or call all tower events downward strikes. Bind counts to event definitions and periods; random-location odds, exact annual rates, the idiom and strikes to people stay outside scope unless separately sourced. Deliver exact revision/body-hash review with explicit scope corrections and accept/revise/abstain reasoning; no automatic adoption or route approval.
